test_YamlVersion_from_string: test YamlVersion.from_string to parse a semantic version string like 1.2.3 into major minor patch fields
test_YamlVersion_get_version_str: test YamlVersion.get_version_str to convert a version tuple back into a dotted string like 1.2.3
test_YamlVersion_comparison: test YamlVersion comparison operators to verify semantic version ordering between two version instances
test_ValueType_enum_values: test ValueType enum to verify all four members Int Float String Object have correct integer values
test_AttributeSpec_equality: test AttributeSpec equality to verify two specs with the same name raw_name value_type and default_value compare equal
